items.title: Bitcoin crashes ~6% to a 7-week low near $75.5K as Nasdaq selloff erases midterm gains
items.excerpt: BTC fell to about $75.5K (lowest since mid-September) as US equities reversed post-election gains and crypto liquidations mounted.

items.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs reverse to a $430.2M net outflow on Nov 5 after one day of inflows
items.excerpt: SoSoValue: FBTC −$199.9M and IBIT −$105.0M led the $430.2M spot Bitcoin ETF outflow, wiping Nov 4's $74.6M inflow.

items.title: Core Scientific to exit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI colocation takes over
items.excerpt: Management says mining wind-down finishes in Q4; colocation hit $215.4M last quarter while self-mining fell to $12.3M.
